gloss: the very last; dead last; tail end

definitions.gloss: the very last; dead last; tail end
definitions.explanation: An emphatic, informal word meaning the absolute last position or the very end of a line, race, or ranking. More emphatic than simply 最後.

examples.japanese: マラソンでどん{尻|じり}だった。
examples.english: I came in dead last in the marathon.

examples.japanese: あのチームはいつもどん{尻|じり}だ。
examples.english: That team is always in last place.

examples.japanese: {成績|せいせき}がどん{尻|じり}だったので、{必死|ひっし}に{勉強|べんきょう}するようになった。
examples.english: My grades were dead last, so I started studying desperately.

notes:
USAGE:
An informal, emphatic expression. The prefix どん adds emphasis, similar to how it works in どん底 (rock bottom). Often used in sports, rankings, and competitive contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どん{尻|じり}に{終|お}わる (to end up dead last)
- どん{尻|じり}から{数|かぞ}えた{方|ほう}が{早|はや}い (easier to count from the bottom)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最下位|さいかい}: last place — a more formal, neutral expression
- びり: last place — a casual synonym
- どん{底|ぞこ}: rock bottom — the same emphatic prefix applied to "bottom"
